checksum.description: CS1: image's own segment table @0x500/0x510/0x514 (OS + 7 cal segments). CS2/CVN: CRC-16/ARC over CS2 blocks per reference/P01-P59.xml; stock OS CVN 717A for 12225074 matches reference/stockcvn.xml.

security_access.reference: GmKeys.cs + security.rs (Level 1 for read/DTC, Level 2 for flash programming)

maps_and_xdf.description: Full TunerPro XDF with tables for spark advance, fuel VE, idle, etc. Addresses and scalings defined. Can be imported or manually ported to app map catalogue.
maps_and_xdf.kernel_for_flash: Kernel-P01.bin (7.7 KB) - uploaded to RAM for flash ops
maps_and_xdf.xdf_file_note: reference/OS-12225074-512Kb-2001-2004.xdf is a TunerPro binary/encrypted XDF; parse_xdf_definitions returns a clear error. Use a text XDF or a definition pack.

communication_kernels: Kernel-P01.bin (7890 bytes @ 0xFF8000; read established by PcmHammer log; erase/write missing)

recovery_paths.locked_pcm_grounding_hack: For tuner-locked P01: Apply ground to specific solder pad (public DIY guides) during write/erase phase to bypass lock and allow reflash. Time grounding with 'erasing' stage for success. Safety: Stable power, correct pad identification critical.
recovery_paths.bricked_or_failed_flash_recovery: DIY Gen3 GM bricked PCM recovery: Ground the correct solder pad on P01/P59 PCB (near flash chip or test point, red/blue connectors). Hold during write if needed. Use recovery kernel reflash. Critical: Stable battery voltage >12.5V recommended, use bench power supply. Public community tutorials detail exact pad location.
recovery_paths.auto_prompt: The guided pipeline must detect flash failure or lock and auto-prompt for recovery kernel upload (Kernel-P01.bin) + step-by-step grounding assistance with clear warnings, diagrams references, and confirmation steps.
recovery_paths.low_level_reflash: Support uploading recovery kernel to RAM and performing low-level full OS reflash, bypassing normal calibration locks where hardware allows.

notes: Already heavily integrated in Rust backend (vpw.rs, security.rs, checksum.rs, flash.rs, pid_decode.rs, dtc.rs). This DB entry centralizes metadata so frontend/app can auto-detect P01 on connect (VIN/OS ID), load correct checksum routine + seedkey, and reference XDF/maps. Enhanced with public recovery procedures scraped from tuning community resources for the safe guided flashing pipeline. Use with affordable open tools like PCMHammer patterns.
